LanguageData.Gun_Sterling_L2A3_RWP.description: The Sterling L2A3 is a compact, fully-automatic submachine gun known for its reliability and ease of use. Crafted from durable materials, it offers decent stopping power for close-quarter combat with a high rate of fire, making it an effective choice for colonists needing to engage threats at short range.
